name: human-pace
description: Human-paced replies: bionic reading, answer first, short chunks, action markers and a length cap, each toggleable with /pace.

configurationSource.title: Configuration source
configurationSource.description: Choose native to use this panel, or commands to use /pace and your existing settings file.

bionicGradient.title: Experimental gradient
bionicGradient.description: HTML previews only; ordinary chat uses bolding.

anchorTrigger.title: Anchor word length
anchorTrigger.description: Minimum word length for an extra anchor (2–50).

answerFirst.title: Answer first
answerFirst.description: Start with the answer or outcome.

length.title: Word limit
length.description: Maximum prose words; 0 removes the limit.

driftGuard.title: Reminder interval
driftGuard.description: Resend rules every N prompts; 0 disables reminders.
